en.topic_title: Gov’t loses appeal against acquittal of former lawmaker Lam Cheuk-ting over 2019 protest charge
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s Department of Justice (DoJ) has lost its appeal against a lower court’s decision to acquit former lawmaker Lam Cheuk-ting of a perverting the course of justice charge linked to the 2019 protests and unrest.



Lam Cheuk-ting, Photo: LegCo Screenshot.



A panel of three Court of Appeal judges delivered the judgment on Friday, upholding a previous ruling that found Lam and two co-defendants not guilty.



The case relates to a confrontation after a protest at Tuen Mun Park
